unresolved.question: Surah header box prints no Arabic surah name, so 'arabic' is null. The Bengali ruku sign ع beside verse circle ২৬ is not encoded.
Band digits ১, ২, ৩, ৪, ৬ are printed without a circle (enclosure 'none'), although the legend circles them; the ৬ glyph is rounded and could be read as circled.
২ appears over nun sakin / tanween before an ikhfa letter (rows 3, 5, 6, 8, 9); label taken from legend ② (দম ফেলিলে দুই আলিফ) but the fit is doubtful.
Rows 7-8: the sign وقفة printed above verse circles ১৭, ১৮, ১৯, ২০ has no Unicode equivalent; encoded as ۜ (small seen) on the ayah's last word.
Row 8: the waqf sign after فَذَكِّرْ is a small ط above قف; encoded as ؕ on فَذَكِّرْ (mid-ayah, 88:21).

Row 5: the sign above verse circle ১২ is a small meem (waqf lazim), encoded ۘ on جَارِيَةٌ; it could also be read as a stray damma-shaped mark. A solid down arrow is printed in the band above that circle; recorded with layer 'band' on the last letter of جَارِيَةٌ with the catalog label. A right-margin note beside rows 3-5 with a left arrow probably explains it but is illegible.
Rows 7, 8, 10: solid down arrows printed in the band above verse circles ১৮, ২০ and ২৬ are recorded with layer 'band' on the last letter of the preceding word, with the catalog label.
Row 9: بِمُصَيْطِرٍ is printed with a small س (U+06DC) above the ص; a right-margin note says to read it with ص only here.
Row 1: the band sign over يَّوْمَئِذٍ (x≈905) is partly cut by the header frame; read as গ.
